Targ. Job XV, 23 (some ed. מַנְדַּד part. pass. Af. driven about).

senses.gloss: to make (sleep) flee, to keep awake. Targ. Esth. l. c. נַדֵּיד ed. Lag. (ed. Amst. נְדַד; oth. ed. נַדֵּי; corr. acc.).
to cause to be sleepless. Targ. II Esth. l. c.
